reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every weekend/holiday path in the tree already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is one extra comparison inside the single predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts, and the format is documented on the RecurConfig type.

scope.why: A minimal edit to the predicate plus a type comment, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, commented and centralised, so a maintainer would take it on easily.
